finding.title: Reset failed IDB open promise and close a late orphan result
finding.scenario: open() caches this.database before request.onerror/onblocked. Those callbacks reject but never reset that cached promise. A later explicit retry (including following the close-other-tab guidance) reuses the same rejection and never calls factory.open again. In blocked->late-success sequence, onsuccess resolves an already-rejected promise and leaves the returned database open; close() awaits the rejected promise and cannot obtain that database.
evidence: journal115–124 cached open promise, error and blocked handlers
journal122 late onsuccess only assigns onversionchange and resolve
journal245 close catches rejection to undefined, cannot close orphan result
finding.required: Track the actual in-flight open attempt, clear only that failed attempt so a later explicit retry can open again, and handle/close success that arrives after that attempt was invalidated or abandoned. Do not auto-resend any command or create a background retry loop.
laterValidation: first open fails, explicit retry invokes a second successful open and preserves original command key
blocked attempt rejects, later success is closed once rather than orphaned
late error/success from old attempt cannot clear/replace a newer attempt

limits: Source control-flow finding only, no real IndexedDB or browser behavior executed
Existing direct event-port test lacks open error/blocked events; do not claim its transaction cases cover this
